# F.R.I. Marketing

> F.R.I. Marketing is a retail representation firm that gets brands onto the shelf at Walmart and Sam's Club. Founded in 1997 by former Walmart insiders and based in Bentonville, Arkansas, the firm has generated more than $200M in retail sales for its clients.

Full-spectrum retail representation for CPG brands entering or scaling within Walmart and Sam's Club — sales strategy, vendor integration, product launches, e-commerce guidance, analytics and reporting, international expansion, and social positioning. Contact: jdemaree1@cox.net, (479) 640-7745.
